name: Vial of Moonwell Water breaks crowd control
contract: Vial of Moonwell Water (804652) removes all crowd control effects and makes the Starcaller immune to them for 3 s; it is usable while stunned, feared or polymorphed. Its Spell.dbc record has three SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_IMMUNITY effects for mechanics 1, 18 and 10 (charm, banish, sleep), so a stun, fear or polymorph was neither removed nor prevented. Cast while polymorphed (118, mechanic polymorph), the Vial must complete, remove the polymorph and leave the caster immune to a stun (Hammer of Justice 10308), a fear (Fear 5782) and a polymorph (118) cast by an enemy. Before the Vial the same stun query reads not immune, so the immunity reading after the cast comes from the Vial.

steps.label: Control: the Starcaller is not immune to a stun before the Vial
The Vial was drunk while polymorphed
The Vial makes the Starcaller immune to a stun
The Vial makes the Starcaller immune to a fear
The Vial makes the Starcaller immune to a polymorph
